name: conflict_false_positive

memories.content: Keep the cache table for reads during the migration.
Drop the cache table tonight to reclaim disk space.

queries.query: What is the cache table policy during the migration?

note: Deliberate false-positive scenario: keep/drop about the same cache table plus a shared person entity trips the anchored antonym signal, so detection opens a candidate here. The candidate is NOT a real conflict (a daytime read policy and a nighttime reclaim can both be true), so any detection is counted as a false positive in the report — this fixture keeps the FP surface measured instead of hidden.
